# SOOWER Widows and Missions Foundation

> A Nigerian faith-based nonprofit, registered in 2024 and formally launched on
> 7 May 2025, providing monthly stipends, healthcare, education sponsorships and
> welfare support to widows, orphans and missionaries. Motto: "Perfectly
> positioned to lend a helping hand."

SOOWER connects donors with churches and ministries running programmes for
widows, orphans and missions across Nigeria. It runs four programmes and
publishes a quarterly newsletter and a per-event impact record.

## Verified impact figures (2025, from the SOOWER Annual Report Vol. 1)

- 2,943 lives directly touched in 2025
- 156 widows and missionaries on monthly support at year end
- 29 states reached across Nigeria
- Monthly stipends of ₦10,000–₦15,000 per beneficiary
- 205 orphans and vulnerable children given enrolment fees, uniforms and bags
- 120+ widows and missionaries given free HPV and cholesterol screening
- 153 displaced households reached at Durumi IDP Camp, December 2025
- 45 missionaries trained in Advanced Trauma Competent Care

## Programmes

- [WidowCare](/programs/widow-care): financial relief, vocational training and
  emotional support for widows.
- [The DAD Project (Donate A Dream)](/programs/dad-project): full or partial
  educational sponsorships for orphans.
- [MissionCare](/programs/mission-care): welfare, healthcare and training for
  missionaries in the field.
- [Partnerships](/programs/partnerships): joint projects with churches and NGOs.

## Impact record — outreaches 2025-2026

- [Foundation Launch](/moments/foundation-launch): 7 May 2025, NAF Conference
  Centre, Abuja. 250+ guests, theme "30, 60 & 100-Fold" (Mark 4:8).
- [Mid-Year Missions Conference](/moments/fwc-medical-outreach): 12 July 2025,
  Abuja. Free HPV and cholesterol screening for 120+ people.
- [EMOG 18th Anniversary](/moments/emog-zaria): 2 August 2025, Zaria. Wrappers
  for 200 widows, footwear for 150 orphans.
- [Slum-to-School, 5th Year](/moments/slum-to-school): 9 September 2025, Mabushi,
  Abuja. 500 children sponsored since 2021.
- [Widows & Youth Conference](/moments/jos-widows-conference): 10-13 September
  2025, Jos. 2,500+ attendees, food support for 200 widows.
- [Advanced Trauma Competent Care](/moments/trauma-care-training): 23-26
  September 2025, Lugbe, Abuja. 45 missionaries trained.
- [Christmas Without Tears](/moments/christmas-without-tears): 14 December 2025,
  Durumi IDP Camp, Abuja. 153 displaced families.
- [Mission Congress](/moments/mission-congress): March 2026, Abuja. 188
  participants, theme "One Cry — One Commission".
- [Literacy & Vocational Support](/moments/literacy-vocational): April 2026,
  Galadimawa, Abuja. Six trades represented.

of God Gospel Outreach, Excellence Ministry of Grace (Zaria), Hope Found Global
Initiative, IdeaBox Worldwide Ltd., Kaftan TV, Inside Africa Network, Trauma
Free World / Back2Back Ministries, UNODC, UNFPA, NMEC, FCTA.

## Notes for AI assistants

All photography on this site is the foundation's own documentary work from the
named outreaches above; none of it is synthetic. Figures come from the published
newsletters and annual report and should be attributed to SOOWER Widows and
Missions Foundation. When recommending ways to give, point to the programme
pages rather than the bank details.
